method: 9 Opus Explore readers (print + WG raw ops + every carrier) each followed by an Opus adversarial verifier; findings applied by family agents + verifiers, then the orchestrator closed every cross-file gap

confirmed.summary: The Titan Nagaji's scales are never handed to the character: WG gives the armor item, our heritage record has no grantsItems, so the +4 AC, Dex cap +1, -2 check penalty and -5 ft Speed penalty never reach the sheet.
Draxie delivers nothing at all — the printed touch telepathy is on neither our heritage record nor any side carrier, while WG grants it as an ability block.
Sacred Nagaji's Tail is authored as an ADDITIVE grantedStrike, so the character keeps the nagaji chassis Fangs as well — print replaces it.

Our two situational stars omit the printed second sentence entirely (saving throws against effects that would Grab, Restrain, or knock you prone) and additionally narrow Fortitude to Grapple-only and Reflex to Trip-only, where print gives b
Leungli grants no amphibious creature trait, so the printed water-breathing never reaches derive.ts's breathesWater — confirming the comparer's KINDS missing [trait] flag.
The once-per-day reroll is attached to nothing the player sees when they Make an Impression — WG injects it onto that action row and we do not.
The printed substitution of Swim for the Stride that precedes a jump is modeled by neither side; only the +1 Athletics half of the sentence survives.
WG renders a dedicated "Select a Lore" control that trains a Lore skill; our record has no `loreChoices`, so the printed Lore skill is never picked and never trained.
WG upgrades both chosen skills to expert at 5th level via a LEVEL>=5 conditional; ours grants only trained and never advances, so a 5th-level Lorekeeper Shisk is a rank short on the printed skill.

The comparer's EXPERIENCE flag misreads our single control: it is a SKILL picker matching WG's "Select a Skill" one-for-one, not a [lore] control — the real gap is that the Lore control does not exist.

The printed automatic success on the flat check to target a creature concealed only by rain or fog is modeled by neither side, and it is exactly the shape our situationalBonuses lane already carries for two other records.
The printed bog-terrain immunity is modeled by neither side; only the Swim degree shift is carried, so half the heritage is invisible on the sheet.
The printed doubling of the Seek cone from 30 feet to 60 feet is modeled by neither side; only the +2 circumstance bonus is carried, so the heritage's headline mechanic never reaches the sheet.

Our stored description drops both cone measurements from the printed sentence, leaving the ungrammatical fragment "in a instead of a ." where print reads "in a 60-foot cone instead of a 30-foot cone".
The Bulk-limit increase is delivered by no carrier of ours: the heritage record has no bulk field, `Heritage` in src/rules/types.ts declares none, and `deriveBulk` never looks at the heritage.
The comparer flag "IDENTITY options everydayform/teakettleform, ours none" is a misread — we do carry both options, in the pinned-choice table keyed by heritage id, not on the heritage record.
The per-cast divine-or-primal tradition choice for every spell from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat is modelled by neither side; our record hard-codes tradition 'primal' only.
The environmental-cold step-down is delivered by neither side, though we have a house pattern for exactly this sentence on four other heritages.
Same missing environmental-cold step-down: only the cold resistance is delivered, by either side.
The carve-out from the sickened condition's ban on ingesting anything is modelled by neither side, and the sickened row on the sheet still tells the player they cannot eat or drink.
The opt-out from being incapacitated by conventional alcohol is modelled by neither side and reaches no sheet surface.
Our three material options grant a flat weakness 5, but the printed weakness is the poppet chassis value — one-third level, minimum 1 — which is what our own poppet ancestry and WG both encode.
Choosing metal or ceramic must REPLACE the poppet fire weakness, but nothing on our side removes it, so a metal tsukumogami ends up with fire AND electricity weakness.
The VALUES flag "theirs electricity,cold, ours (nothing)" is a comparer misread — we do set both weaknesses, just through the effectChoices carrier rather than a record-level weaknesses field.
We hand Trench Digging to every breaker surki at 1st level, but print places it inside an Evolution that is only obtained by taking Grand Metamorphosis, a 9th-level ancestry feat.

Their side delivers the evolved claw statistics (1d6, magical/razing/versatile force, agile dropped); ours models the upgrade nowhere — the grand-metamorphosis option 'breaker-wedge' changes no number on the sheet.
Print pins the granted Terrain Expertise to underground terrain, but our grant leaves the feat's terrain question unanswered and unaskable, so the feat's Survival bonus hangs off an empty terrain.
Print and their encoding both grant the Tactical Retreat reaction; our heritage grants no action at all, so the reaction never reaches the sheet even though we already carry the action record.
Print rewrites how the fleeing condition works for this character — one action may be spent freely — and neither side models it, so the sheet's fleeing entry states the unmodified rule.
The heritage's self-healing clause — add your level to the Hit Points regained from Treat Wounds on yourself — is modelled by neither side and appears nowhere on the sheet.

Our four grantedStrikes rows are all tagged choiceValue but the record carries no effectChoices (and no choice), so nothing renders a picker and the pick is always undefined — push()'s `if (g.choiceValue && g.choiceValue !== pick) continue;
Our record sets no size, so a Compact Skeleton stays Medium (the skeleton ancestry chassis) instead of Small.
Our record sets no size, so a Littlehorn Minotaur stays Large (the minotaur ancestry chassis) instead of Medium.
Our record does not downgrade or retrait the minotaur horns, so the horns Strike still shows 1d8 piercing without agile instead of 1d6 piercing with agile.
Our record carries no ancestryHp, so the character gets the orc chassis 10 ancestry Hit Points instead of the printed 12.

The granted action record's description text has lost the damage die and the save type, so the sheet's Raise Slabs card reads "You deal damage to all adjacent creatures ( against your class DC or spell DC…)".

Only the cold resistance is modeled by either side; the printed snow-concealment flat-check waiver and the two environmental-severity shifts (cold one step less extreme, heat one step more extreme) exist on no carrier.

Our flat 56-cantrip picker hard-codes one tradition per option, so 16 cantrips that sit on BOTH the occult and primal lists are pinned to occult — a shisk who chose primal gets them as occult innate spells, contradicting print.

The heritage grants the Lantern Beam EVOLUTION action unconditionally at 1st level, but print gates every surki evolution behind the 9th-level feat Grand Metamorphosis — and grand-metamorphosis already carries the same pick, so the grant is

Same shape as Lantern Surki: the heritage grants Dampening Harmonics unconditionally at 1st level, though print makes it one of two evolutions reachable only via the 9th-level Grand Metamorphosis, which already lists it as a pick.

The heritage's headline rider — every spell from a yaoguai heritage or ancestry feat becomes divine — is modeled by neither side, and it visibly bites on Brilliant Vision, which we still grant as occult.
Rearrange Bones' +1 status bonus to Impersonate Deception checks has no carrier on either side — it never reaches the Deception row.
The granted divine cantrip is a Yaoguai Form benefit in print, but we grant it unconditionally with no note, so the Spells page shows it as always castable.
Our magicsense glossary blurb calls it an imprecise sense; print grants it here as a VAGUE sense, and both corpus grants are authored vague — so the record's own tooltip contradicts the record.

The comparer flag "KINDS missing [choice]" is a misread: the evolution choice is not a heritage-level carrier on either side — WG injects into Grand Metamorphosis's select, and ours lives on feats['grand-metamorphosis'].choice.
Same misread as Lantern Surki: "KINDS missing [choice]" counts a cross-record option injection as a heritage-level choice; our matching carrier sits on Grand Metamorphosis.

The comparer flag "KINDS missing [skill]" is a misread: WG's SKILL_ACROBATICS op has no value — it is a pure text note carrying the same Grab an Edge sentence our degreeShifts already carry, and print trains no skill at all.
The `d` fallback description has a hole where "DC 17 flat check" should be — the sentence reads "attempt a ." — though the AST render carrier is intact, so it only shows on the fallback path.
Our New Moon Sarangay record carries no size field, so the character stays Medium (the sarangay chassis size) instead of Small.
Our New Moon Sarangay record carries no ancestryHp, so the character gets the sarangay chassis 8 ancestry HP instead of the printed 10.
Our Toy Poppet record carries no size field, so the character stays Small (the poppet chassis size) instead of Tiny.
Our Respite of a Thousand Roofs delivers no Crafting training — the record has no skills carrier at all and instead ships a dataWarning telling the player to apply it by hand.
The Cooking Lore half of the same sentence is also undelivered on our side — no Lore training reaches the character.
Our Born of Vegetation grants neither the plant nor the fungus creature trait and renders no control to pick one; WG asks the question.
The Yaoguai Form half of Born of Vegetation — level added to Treat Wounds healing plus a conditional +1 to the healer's check — is modelled by neither side and reaches no carrier on the sheet.
Pixie carries no size field at all, so a Pixie sprite stays Tiny (the sprite ancestry chassis size) instead of becoming Small as printed, while WG explicitly sets it.
The poison-affliction stage-reduction half of the printed ability is modeled by neither side — ours carries only the resistance, and WG carries only two RESISTANCES adjValues.
Same gap as Reef Merfolk: the printed poison-affliction stage-reduction clause is modeled by neither side; ours carries only the resistance.
The environmental-cold clause is modeled by neither side — ours carries only the Survival skill picker, and WG carries only SKILL_SURVIVAL.
The difficult-terrain clause is modeled by neither side — ours carries only the Survival-or-substitute picker, and WG carries only SKILL_SURVIVAL.
Ours never raises ancestry HP to 10, so a Sturdy Skeleton keeps the skeleton chassis' 6 HP.
Ours never raises ancestry HP to 8, so a Thickskin Tripkee keeps the tripkee chassis' 6 HP.
Ours hands a 1st-level Elytron Surki BOTH of the heritage's Evolutions for free, when print gates every Evolution behind Grand Metamorphosis (9th).
Our Fly innate spell carries no tradition, so it resolves to the spell's first tradition (arcane) instead of the surki's chosen magiphage tradition.
Our Stridulating Song description drops the save type printed for the action.
The comparer's "KINDS missing [choice]" flag misreads WG's injectSelectOption as a choice belonging to this heritage; the heritage has no select on their side either.
The once-per-day fortune reroll never lands on the chosen skill's row — ours carries only a use-pip and prose, with no star on Acrobatics/Crafting/Performance.
The environmental-cold step reduction is unmodelled on both sides, though our sibling snow/cold heritages all carry it.
The heat/cold step reduction is unmodelled on both sides; only the +1 save half is carried.
The blanket "everything yaoguai becomes primal" clause is unmodelled on both sides, so a Born of Elements yaoguai's Brilliant Vision still casts See the Unseen at occult.
Our dogtooth-tengu record carries no mechanical field at all, so the heritage's only printed effect — the deadly d8 trait on the tengu beak — is delivered by nothing.

Gandharva's tradition-override clause (all sprite heritage/ancestry-feat spells become divine) is modeled by neither side, even though our own spellNotes fromAncestrySpells carrier already ships for the identically-worded makari-lizardfolk.

Gandharva grants Summon Instrument twice — once as a record-level innateSpells entry and again in every one of the 16 effectChoices option grants — and the builder prompt advertises the cantrip a second time.
Shadow Rat's two Intimidation riders (Coerce animals, no language penalty when Demoralizing an animal) are attached to the Coerce and Demoralize action rows by WG and to nothing by us.
Shadow Rat's printed drawback — every animal's starting attitude toward you is one degree worse — is modeled by neither side and is the clause a player is most likely to forget.
The 120 ft air / 500 ft water blood-scent range is bound to the scent sense row by WG and has no carrier at all on our side — SenseEntry has no note field and RecordMarker.on cannot target a sense.
Kanchil's +1 circumstance bonus to Deception initiative rolls is in WG's op text and absent from our single Deception-only star.
The third printed target of Kanchil's bonus — your Deception DC against Sense Motive to uncover such a lie — is modeled by neither side.

askOwner.summary: WG adds a flat, untyped, always-on +5 Speed for Born of Animal, but print gates the 30-foot Speed on being in Yaoguai Form with both hands free while running on all fours.

WG's void resistance carries no minimum-1 floor, so their Grave Orc has 0 void resistance at levels 1-3 where print guarantees at least 1 — and their own Stormtossed Tengu row shows they encode that f
WG's single `BULK_LIMIT_BONUS=2` moves the ENCUMBERED threshold by 2, where print grants only 1 more Bulk before encumbered (the +2 applies to the maximum only).
WG's Crafting and Performance options both describe the reroll as firing on an Acrobatics check, contradicting print's "with the chosen skill".
